cards.claim: Pier Crescenzi's profession is that of a Catholic cardinal.
cards.quote: Pier Paolo Crescenzi Pier Paolo Crescenzi (1572 – 19 February 1645) was an Italian Catholic cardinal.

On 4 Jul 1612 , he was appointed during the papacy of Pope Paul V as Bishop of Rieti . [ 4 ] On 15 Jul 1612 , he was consecrated bishop by Bonifazio Caetani , Bishop of Cassano all'Jonio , with Fabio Biondi , Titular Patriarch of Jerusalem , and Galeazzo Sanvitale , Archbishop Emeritus of Bari-Canosa , serving as co-consecrators . [ 4 ] On 17 Mar 1621 , he was appointed Bishop of Orvieto .
